items.title: Employee Retention Rate Calculator
items.description: Want to know the rate at which your organization retains its employees? Use our free employee retention rate calculator.
highlighted: Use our free employee retention rate calculator

items.markdown:
### Employee Retention Rate Formula

To calculate your employee retention rate, use this standard formula:[[1]](https://www.assessteam.com/how-to-calculate-employee-retention-rate-formula-calculator-strategies-to-improve-retention/)

Retention Rate=(Number of employees remaining at the end of the period Number of employees at the beginning of the period)×100 Retention Rate equals open paren the fraction with numerator Number of employees remaining at the end of the period and denominator Number of employees at the beginning of the period end-fraction close paren cross 100 R e t e n t i o n R a t e=N u m b e r o f e m p l o y e e s r e m a i n i n g a t t h e e n d o f t h e p e r i o d N u m b e r o f e m p l o y e e s a t t h e b e g i n n i n g o f t h e p e r i o d×1 0 0

*Note: Do not include employees hired during the measurement period in the numerator or denominator, as the goal is to track how many of your original workforce stayed.* [[1]](https://www.cultureamp.com/blog/how-to-calculate-employee-retention-rate)[[2]](https://www.assessteam.com/how-to-calculate-employee-retention-rate-formula-calculator-strategies-to-improve-retention/)


---

### Step-by-Step Calculation Example

1. **Start of Period (S):** You have **150 employees** on January 1.
2. **During the Period:** **18 employees** leave.
3. **End of Period (E):** You have **132 original employees** remaining (150 - 18 = 132).
4. **Divide & Multiply:**(1 3 2÷1 5 0)×1 0 0=𝟖𝟖%[[1]](https://www.assessteam.com/how-to-calculate-employee-retention-rate-formula-calculator-strategies-to-improve-retention/)


---

### Online Calculators & Benchmarks
You can evaluate your metrics using online tools and sector data:

- Use the [COMPT Employee Retention Rate Calculator](https://compt.io/tools/employee-retention-rate-calculator/) to check your numbers against 2026 industry benchmarks (such as 88% in Tech/Software or 92% in Finance/Insurance).
- Check the [Myles Wellbeing Employee Retention Rate Calculator](https://www.myleswellbeing.com/calculators/employee-retention-rate-calculator) for a quick step-by-step digital walkthrough.[[1]](https://compt.io/tools/employee-retention-rate-calculator/)[[2]](https://www.myleswellbeing.com/calculators/employee-retention-rate-calculator)

If you'd like, share your numbers (starting head count, departures, and time frame) and I will calculate your **exact retention rate** for you.
